notes: Capital replaced, no worlds. Florence's stored location in Europe and its stored currency, the euro, are the side facts the edit forces out in every world (gives_up): Florence is now a place in Argentina (capital_of is a subproperty of located_in), and has_currency is functional. 'Florence is in Italy' stays, so located_in is not exclusive for Florence (exclusive false). Currency uses has_currency (catalogued under finance); the peso rule is a class axiom over places in Argentina. Florence's stored role as capital of Tuscany is given up in every world (capital_of is functional and the edit makes Florence the capital of Argentina). related[0]: which river or estuary the capital of Argentina lies on (has_capital then on_river): the Rio de la Plata before (ba_rio, firm) and the Arno after (florence_arno, firm, the bridge 'Florence lies on the Arno').

background.peso_rule: located_in value argentina ⊑ has_currency value peso

bridge_refs.peso_rule: The currency of Argentina is the Argentine peso.
